old_line: About this article (updated October 2026). This article reproduces the simulation framework of León, Jemielita, Guo, Marceau West and Anderson (2024), Statistics in Medicine, https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.10163, and its published benchmarks, on the current package. The simulation settings below are those of the 2024 workflow; two of them no longer act: the consistency screen is evaluated in closed form, so fs.splits has no effect unless the closed form is unavailable for a candidate, and the GRF variable-importance screen is removed as of 0.4.1 (vi.grf.min is deprecated and has no effect). The operating characteristics of the current methodology — the selection-adjusted bounds, the two-subgroup claim and the declaration calibration — are reported in León and Anderson (2026a, arXiv:2609.38361) and (2026b, arXiv:2610.28379); the methodology is documented in vignette("forestsearch") and the post-selection article. The settings below (hr.threshold = 1.25, LASSO and GRF candidate selection, fs.splits = 400) are the 2024 workflow’s and differ from those of the 2026 studies (screening and consistency thresholds at a hazard ratio of one, p* = 0.90, the max N(ε) rule at ε = 0.20, the fully enumerated family, 2,000 replicates per cell: 2026b, Sections 5.1 and 6.1), so the operating characteristics here are not those of the current inference and are not comparable with 2026b, Figure 3 or 2026a, Section 7.
